data.narrative:
Arena AI, a Series B-stage defense and security software company founded by Pratap Ranade and Engin Ural, has raised $62M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Allen Control Systems, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, and Twenty.

Two triangulation methods yield distinct but reconcilable results. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $62M total raised proxy, implying a $118M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 8 same-stage, same-sector private comparables yields a $1.1B implied value, with the peer set ranging from $300M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). The wide peer dispersion reflects material differences in revenue, growth trajectory, or customer concentration within the defense AI segment.

Triangulating both methods produces a median valuation of $621M, with a defensible range between $100M (conservative) and $1.3B (peers-weighted). The low end reflects the stage-progression anchor; the high end tracks peer-median methodology. Key uncertainties include Arena AI's revenue and customer composition relative to the peer set, which exhibit three-fold valuation variance at comparable stage. Customer concentration in government contracts and near-term revenue visibility will be primary drivers of final valuation within this range.
